use_frequency_to_ind: use the Frequency class to convert seconds to sample indices for audio signal processing
use_frequency_to_sec: use the Frequency class to convert sample indices back to seconds for audio signal processing
use_swap_state: use the swap_state context manager to temporarily swap a PyTorch model's state dict and restore it
use_flatten_dict: use flatten_dict to merge a dict of dicts into a single dict with slash-separated keys
use_write_and_rename: use write_and_rename to safely write a file via a temp file then atomic rename to avoid corruption
